sourceText:
Boiled Pork
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 6:02am

Ingredients




4 pounds Boneless pork roast, trim off as much fat as possible
1 Yellow onion, peeled, sliced
2 Carrots, chopped
2 Bay leaves
2 teaspoons Whole thyme leaves
1 teaspoon Whole sage leaves
6 sprgs parsley, whole
10 whls black peppercorns
teaspoon Salt

Preparation

1 Since plantation owners like Washington and Jefferson cured so many hams each year, we may assume that there was a lot of pork around to be eaten. 2 Some could be cured in the form of sausage and kept for a time but large cuts were often boiled. This is a very delicious way to enjoy pork. I think 3 Place the pork in a Dutch oven or kettle just barely large enough to hold the meat. Add water to halfway up the side of the meat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and bring to a boil. Turn to simmer and cook the meat until tender, about 1-1/4 hours. Remove the meat from the broth and slice at the table. 4 This is great with Cooked Greens with Garlic and Tomato and some Monticello Muffins.
